rows.reasoning: SB 1828 (2021), 'omnibus; taxation', which Mesnard prime-sponsored and voted Yea on at Third Reading, combines an individual income-tax rate cut (phased to a flat 2.5%) with unrelated provisions on unemployment-insurance wage bases, property-tax formulas, sales-tax exemptions and targeted credits.
